create_bitmasks_from_tensor: create a BitMasks object from a PyTorch bool tensor of shape N,H,W representing segmentation masks
convert_polygons_to_bitmask: convert a list of polygon coordinate arrays into a binary bitmask numpy array using pycocotools
rasterize_polygons_within_box: rasterize polygons into a cropped and resized mask tensor for Mask R-CNN training targets
create_polygonmasks_from_list: create a PolygonMasks object from a nested list of polygon coordinate arrays for instance segmentation
crop_and_resize_masks: crop each mask by its bounding box and resize to a fixed size using ROIAlign for Mask R-CNN
